commands.command: set -eu; printf 'node=%s ip=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$NODE_IP"; printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; printf 'os='; . /etc/os-release; printf '%s %s\n' "$ID" "$VERSION_ID"; id; systemctl is-system-running; systemctl status inventory-worker --no-pager 2>&1 || true; ls -ld /var/lib/inventory 2>&1 || true
